summary: Tested Email Configuration feature (Event Detail → Settings → Email Configuration). All 23 backend API tests pass (100%). Frontend UI verified working - all 5 email scenarios display correctly with Enabled/Override toggles, editable template fields when override is ON, read-only global preview when override is OFF, Save Changes, Reset to Global, and Preview functionality all work correctly. Send Test button is correctly disabled when email provider is not configured.
seed_data_creation: Global email templates exist in email_templates table with event_id=null. Event 1 can have event-specific overrides.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Email Configuration feature fully working. Key features verified: 1) GET /api/events/{eventId}/email-templates - returns all 5 scenarios with global fallback and emailProviderStatus, 2) PUT /api/events/{eventId}/email-templates - saves event-specific templates with override support, 3) POST /api/events/{eventId}/email-templates/reset - resets to global defaults, 4) POST /api/events/{eventId}/email-templates/test - sends test email (returns 400 with 'not configured' message when provider not set up), 5) GET /api/events/{eventId}/email-templates/status - returns provider availability. Frontend: Settings > Email Configuration page shows all 5 scenarios (Registration Completed, Payment Successful, Event Reminder, Event Cancelled, Post-Event Follow-up). Each scenario has Enabled and Override toggles. Override ON shows editable template fields (subject, body, send timing with variable chips). Override OFF shows read-only global template preview. Save Changes persists all scenarios. Reset to Global removes event overrides. Email Provider status displays correctly (amber warning when not configured). Send Test button is disabled when provider not configured. All UI elements have data-testid attributes for testing.
